an8.21:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane Kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an8.21:1.2: Tatra kho Bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi:-- Bhikkhavo ti. Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ. Bhagavā etad avoca:-- 2.
an8.21:1.3: Aṭṭhahi bhikkhave acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgataṃ Uggaṃ gahapatiṃ Vesālikaṃ dhārethā ti.
an8.21:1.5: idaṃ vatvā Sugato uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi. 3.
an8.21:2.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena Uggassa gahapatino Vesālikassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an8.21:2.2: Atha kho Uggo gahapati Vesāliko yena so bhikkhu ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Uggaṃ gahapatiṃ Vesālikaṃ so bhikkhu etad avoca:-- 4.
an8.21:3.1: Aṭṭhahi kho tvaṃ gahapati acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato Bhagavatā vyākato.
an8.21:3.2: Katame te gahapati aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutā dhammā, yehi tvaṃ samannāgato Bhagavatā vyākato ti?
an8.21:3.4: katamehi ahaṃ aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato Bhagavatā vyākato,
an8.21:3.5: api ca bhante ye me aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutā dhammā saṃvijjanti,
an8.21:3.6: te suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, bhāsissāmī' ti.
an8.21:3.7: ‘Evaṃ gahapatī' ti kho so bhikkhu Uggassa gahapatino Vesālikassa paccassosi.
an8.21:3.9: Yadāhaṃ bhante Bhagavantaṃ paṭhamaṃ dūrato 'va addasaṃ,
an8.21:3.10: saha dassanen' eva me bhante Bhagavato cittaṃ pasīdi.
an8.21:3.11: Ayaṃ kho me bhante paṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.21:4.1: So kho ahaṃ bhante pasannacitto Bhagavantaṃ payirupāsiṃ.
an8.21:4.2: Tassa me Bhagavā anupubbikathaṃ kathesi, seyyathīdaṃ
an8.21:4.3: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ, kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi. 6.
an8.21:4.4: Yadā maṃ Bhagavā aññāsi kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittam pasannacittaṃ, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā, taṃ pakāsesi:
an8.21:4.6: Seyyathā pi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakālakaṃ samma-d-eva rajanaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya,
an8.21:4.7: evam eva kho me tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
an8.21:4.8: ‘yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ, sabban taṃ nirodhadhamman' ti.
an8.21:4.9: So kho ahaṃ bhante diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo Satthu sāsane
an8.21:4.10: tatth' eva buddhañ ca dhammañ ca saṅghañ ca saraṇaṃ agamāsiṃ brahmacariyapañcamāni ca sikkhāpadāni samādiyiṃ.
an8.21:4.11: Ayaṃ kho me bhante dutiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati. 7.
an8.21:5.1: Tassa mayhaṃ bhante catasso komāriyo pajāpatiyo ahesuṃ.
an8.21:5.2: Atha khvāhaṃ bhante yena tā pajāpatiyo ten' upasaṅkamiṃ, upasaṅkamitvā tā pajāpatiyo etad avocaṃ
an8.21:5.4: yā icchati, idh' eva bhoge ca bhuñjatu puññāni ca karotu sakāni vā ñātikulāni gacchatu,
an8.21:5.5: hoti vā pana purisādhippāyo, kassa vo dammī' ti?
an8.21:5.6: Evaṃ vutte sā bhante jeṭṭhā pajāpati maṃ etad avoca
an8.21:5.8: Atha khvāhaṃ bhante taṃ purisaṃ pakkosāpetvā vāmena hatthena pajāpatiṃ gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena bhiṅgāraṃ gahetvā tassa purisassa oṇojesiṃ.
an8.21:5.9: Komāriṃ kho panāhaṃ bhante dāraṃ pariccajanto nābhijānāmi cittassa aññathattaṃ.
an8.21:5.10: Ayaṃ kho me bhante tatiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati. 8.
an8.21:6.1: Saṃvijjanti kho pana me bhante kule bhogā,
an8.21:6.2: te ca kho appaṭivibhattā sīlavantehi kalyāṇadhammehi.
an8.21:6.3: Ayaṃ kho me bhante catuttho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati. 9.
an8.21:7.1: Yaṃ kho panāhaṃ bhante bhikkhuṃ payirupāsāmi,
an8.21:7.3: Ayaṃ kho me bhante pañcamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati. 10.
an8.21:8.1: So ce me bhante āyasmā dhammaṃ deseti,
an8.21:8.3: no ce me āyasmā dhammaṃ deseti, aham assa dhammaṃ desemi.
an8.21:8.4: Ayaṃ kho me bhante chaṭṭho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati. 11.
an8.21:9.1: Anacchariyaṃ kho pana maṃ bhante devatā upasaṅkamitvā ārocenti
an8.21:9.3: Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhante tā devatā evaṃ vadāmi
an8.21:9.4: ‘vadeyyātha vā evaṃ kho tumhe devatā no vā vadeyyātha, atha kho svākkhāto Bhagavatā dhammo' ti.
an8.21:9.5: Na kho panāhaṃ bhante abhijānāmi tatonidānaṃ cittassa unnatiṃ
an8.21:9.6: ‘maṃ vā devatā upasaṅkamanti, ahaṃ vā devatāhi saddhiṃ sallapāmī' ti.
an8.21:9.7: Ayaṃ kho me bhante sattamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati. 12.
an8.21:10.1: Yān' imāni bhante Bhagavatā desitāni pañc' orambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni, nāhaṃ tesaṃ kiñci attani appahīnaṃ samanupassāmi.
an8.21:10.2: Ayaṃ kho me bhante aṭṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.21:11.1: Ime kho bhante aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutā dhammā saṃvijjanti.
an8.21:11.3: katamehi pāhaṃ aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato Bhagavatā vyākato ti. 13.
an8.21:12.1: Atha kho so bhikkhu Uggassa gahapatino Vesālikassa nivesane piṇḍapātaṃ gahetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
an8.21:12.2: Atha kho so bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an8.21:12.3: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu, yāvatako ahosi Uggena gahapatinā Vesālikena saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo, taṃ sabbaṃ Bhagavato ārocesi. 14.
an8.21:13.2: yathā taṃ Uggo gahapati Vesāliko sammā vyākaramāno vyākareyya, imeh' eva kho bhikkhu aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato Uggo gahapati Vesāliko mayā vyākato;
an8.21:13.3: imehi ca pana bhikkhu aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgataṃ Uggaṃ gahapatiṃ Vesālikaṃ dhārethā
